cross_relations.kernels: ker D_+=H_0 direct-sum H_- and ker D_-=H_0 direct-sum H_+
cross_relations.closed_ranges: closure ran D_+=H_+ and closure ran D_-=H_-
cross_relations.before_reduction: ker D_+=closure ran D_- iff H_0=0, and similarly with signs exchanged
cross_relations.null_reduction: on H_red=H/H_0 (equivalently H_0^perp), ker(D_+ red)=closure ran(D_- red) and ker(D_- red)=closure ran(D_+ red)

C4_exchange.desired: a unitary F with F H_+=H_-, F H_-=H_+, and F^2=-I
C4_exchange.existence: equivalent to unitary isomorphism H_+ isomorphic to H_-
C4_exchange.infinite_dimension: requires equality of Hilbert dimensions plus compatibility with domains, cutoff bonds, Real/Tate structure, and spectral multiplicity
C4_exchange.noncanonical: balanced dimensions guarantee some F but do not identify it with the source Fourier/Tate twistor

finite_fixture.result: null-free and balanced, hence the observed quotient-contraquotient quarter cycle exists
finite_fixture.warning: this is a structural consequence of its 2x2 balanced inertia, not yet evidence that completed bulk polarities are balanced

correct_order: form the two spectral polarity features
identify and quotient the common zero subspace H_0
compare quotient of one polarity with closed contraquotient range of the other
only then construct/identify the C4 coherencer and positive apex

completed_RH_relevance.endpoint_swap: has balanced finite inertia (1,1) and is a natural location for this cycle
completed_RH_relevance.full_Weil_bulk: need not have balanced inertia; under positivity its negative subspace should disappear, so a global polarity-exchanging C4 on the full form would be the wrong requirement
completed_RH_relevance.typing_rule: apply the quotient-contraquotient C4 cycle to the boundary/endpoint defect block, not automatically to the completed bulk energy operator

next_test: Compute inertia and common nullity of each finite source-selected endpoint/relative-boundary packet under refinement. Require balanced nonzero indices only in the boundary block, exact transport of H_0, and stability of the induced quarter-turn; reject if imbalance grows or if F mixes the positive bulk with the endpoint negative line.
conclusion: The finite quotient-contraquotient result generalizes after quotienting the common zero spectral space. A C4 coherencer exists precisely under balanced polarized inertia. This likely belongs to the rank-two endpoint boundary, while imposing it on the full Weil bulk would conflict with the intended positive completion.
